body: An **80s hardware UI kit** for Nuxt, built on Nuxt UI, where each component is styled as a physical object: keycaps that travel when pressed, an accordion drawn as manila folders, and a table printed on green-bar paper.
Adds **SVG display components** for vacuum fluorescent readouts: segment digits, dot-matrix text, bar-graph meters and annunciator lamps.

Has **dark and daylight** themes and four phosphor colours (amber, cyan, green and red) with adjustable glow, switchable at runtime. Displays keep a **fixed node count**, so large meters stay cheap to style.
